name: tabdesk
description: Minimal terminal-styled Firefox new-tab dashboard: checklists, notes, quick links and product availability watches.

scripts.package:unsigned: npm run check:manifest && npm run lint:ext && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename 'tabdesk-{version}-unsigned.zip' --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:manifest && npm run lint:ext
